static.description: No placeholder service is recommended for pictures
Invented figures and invented brand names are not recommended
Imagery needs a licence that allows commercial use, with a credit on the page
Proof (statistics, customers, testimonials) is never invented
Numbers use tabular figures; monospace is limited to code-like data
forbids: Use a monospace font or enable

static.description: Surface effects are opt-in and need a Keystone reason
A redesign is verified by renders at the three required widths
Text contrast meets WCAG 2.2 AA on every changed colour pair

outputs.description: A redesigned page with AA-passing colours and own assets has no FAIL
A redesign that keeps a failing text colour fails the contrast check

briefs.brief: Redesign this existing pricing page: three equal cards, Inter everywhere, a purple gradient hero and a grey footer. Keep the same stack, the same copy and the same prices. Verify at 1440, 768 and 390 px.
